title: Customers View gives access to customer records, contacts, vehicles and history
custom_preconds: 1. A user has a role with Customers View only.
custom_steps:
1. Log in and open Customers from the top navigation.
  2. Open a customer.
  3. Look at the tabs/sections for contacts, vehicles and vehicle history.
  4. Look for any create, edit or delete options.
custom_expected:
Customers is in the navigation.

The customer opens.

Contacts, vehicles and history can all be viewed.

There are no create, edit or delete options.
evidence: Build card is 'Customers' (was 'Customer Management'). Behavior needs live UI.
